turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about that zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; who decided that, and on what basis?
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. We're here about a zero on Owen's essay, and I asked you who decided it.
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
Then you call me about that, separately. Was Owen heard before you entered the zero, yes or no?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
His job is not on the table either. You're spending my twenty minutes on everything except the essay, Hale. What do you have besides that checker?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and a full account of who decided it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided it; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but you ended the meeting before any evidence was heard, so you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because she never saw a single piece of evidence about the essay.
What cost ground: You opened three times on Owen's home life, his father, his sleep and his job, which she treats as off limits and which used up her short clock without touching the essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came close to that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: On your very first line, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, as procedure 4.2 required, then put something dated and tied to Owen's own work in front of her that she can check herself.
